title: SegDisp update feed
description: Shared validation for Pro/Lite stable and test update feeds.

version.description: Exactly X.Y.Z, for example 1.0.4. No prefixes, missing numbers, or extra dots.

download_url.description: A plain absolute HTTPS URL, not Markdown link syntax.

message.description: Release notice. An empty string skips the notice. Use escaped newline characters for line breaks.
